text: We tested a weak-to-strong generalization setup in which gpt2-small supplies weak labels for llama-3.1-8b, and training examples are filtered by agreement between the weak labels and the strong model's embedding geometry, retaining a select_fraction of 0.5. Across num_seeds = 10 seeds, the method reached a PGR of 0.69 with a standard error of 0.09, against a baseline PGR of 0.49; the baseline falls outside two standard errors of the selection-based estimate, so the data support treating this as a genuine gain rather than seed noise, though the standard error is large enough that the magnitude should be read loosely. Transfer accuracy was 0.73 (SE 0.02), situated between the weak ceiling of 0.61 and the strong model's 0.78, indicating the strong student surpasses its weak supervisor without matching strong-label training. No baseline transfer accuracy or standard error for the baseline PGR was reported, which limits direct comparison on the accuracy scale.
